files.name: POLICY-IN
files.text: SELECT POLICY-IN ASSIGN TO POLIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PI-ST.

files.name: PREMIUM-IN
files.text: SELECT PREMIUM-IN ASSIGN TO PREMIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PR-ST.

files.name: PREMIUM-OUT
files.text: SELECT PREMIUM-OUT ASSIGN TO PREMOUT ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PO-ST.

files.name: ERROR-OUT
files.text: SELECT ERROR-OUT ASSIGN TO ERROUT ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-ER-ST.

move.text: MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF NOT AT END
MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PREM-EOF NOT AT END
MOVE 'POLICY NOT FOUND FOR PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'INVALID POLICY EXPIRY DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'INVALID PREMIUM CALCULATION DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'EXPIRY DATE BEFORE EFFECTIVE DATE' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 31 TO WS-MAX-DAY WHEN 4 WHEN 6 WHEN 9 WHEN 11
MOVE 'POLICY TERM DAYS INVALID' TO ER-MESSAGE

open.text: OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN PREMIUM-IN OUTPUT PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT

if.text: IF NOT PREM-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR
IF WS-YEAR > ZERO AND WS-MONTH >= 1 AND WS-MONTH <= 12
IF WS-REM4 = ZERO AND WS-REM100 NOT = ZERO

compute.text: COMPUTE WS-EARNED ROUNDED = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM * WS-EARNED-DAYS / WS-TERM-DAYS
